entry.title: BMAC Weekly — 2026-W32
entry.summary: 8 papers: misosoup: a metabolic modeling tool for identifying minimal microbial communities, facilitates the exploration of microbial ecology and biotechnological applications; Division of Synthetic Cells Using a Genomically Encoded One-Protein Divisome; Phenotypic heterogeneity in the human gut microbiome revealed by subspecies-resolution single-cell transcriptomics; Hierarchical control of bacterial growth efficiency by substrate and taxonomy; Phage VP882 possesses quorum-sensing-driven lytic induction and stress-mediated host growth suppression mechanisms; Seed-applied multi-kingdom synthetic communities selectively reshape bacterial communities and highlight key criteria for strain selection; Quorum sensing in Klebsiella pneumoniae: An interconnected regulatory network driving virulence and antimicrobial resistance; Structural characterization of stochastic detailed balance in chemical reaction networks

entry.title: BMAC Weekly — 2026-W31
entry.summary: 8 papers: Biphasic bacterial community assembly predicted from generalized first principles of monoculture growth and inferred species interactions; Eco-evolutionary dynamics lead to functionally robust and redundant communities; Drift-driven microbiome simplification generates reconstructable and ecologically cohesive microbial communities; Effects of antibiotic pollution on the composition and antibiotic resistance of freshwater sediment bacterial communities; A single DNA methylation site regulates cell fate during Clostridioides difficile sporulation; Using BONCAT-FACS to probe the active soil microbial community during nitrous oxide production; Assessing the restoration of a seasonally flooded riparian forest through soil carbon and nitrogen cycling indicators and soil microbial communities; Statistical learning of bacterial growth in combinatorially constructed environments

entry.summary: 7 papers: Identifying Non-Ideal Reaction-Diffusion Systems Unable to Maintain Diffusion Out-of-Equilibrium; Kinetic proofreading decouples signal strength and range in paracrine gradient formation; Metabolic adaptations in antibiotic-resistant Staphylococcus aureus : understanding resistance mechanisms and enhancing antibiotic efficacy; Learning proteomic disease trajectories with flow matching; The Pharmacology of Bacterial Persistence: From Antibiotic Tolerance to Antimicrobial Resistance; Asymptotic Thermodynamics for Chemical Reaction Networks with Fast-Slow Kinetics; SMGen: A Generator of Synthetic Models of Biochemical Reaction Networks
